name: The Ooya-san - Tamattemasu yo! Yachin ga!?
original_name: ザ・大家さん たまってますよ！家賃が！？
source:
Ohayama Harumi is the son of apartment complex owner. One day his father gives him a telephone call and asks to gather rent from five girls that are late with the payment.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-february-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
